title: Pi reviewer receives its task after worker completion
description: Set FARMSLOT_GATEWAY and FARMSLOT_PI_REVIEW_PROOF_RUN_ID after replaying review. Reads the actual reviewer signal and checklist through the production gateway.

reviewer-progress.intent: A separate reviewer completes its own checklist while the worker stays complete.

fix-handoff.intent: Reviewer findings reach a fresh fix worker with the scoped checklist.

recovered-completion.intent: Restart recovery settles the completed fix attempt from its actual identity.

delivery-isolation.intent: Review delivery stays isolated and retries only after submission failure.
